result.summary: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being located in a dense urban area with institutional and commercial land uses. The wide roadway and absence of clear lane markings create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this large intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to interpret vehicle signals which may not provide adequate crossing time.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block sight lines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left curbsides near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian crossing infrastructure such as marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps, despite being signalized for vehicles. The surrounding industrial/commercial land use and wide, unmarked roadway create a sterile and potentially high-speed environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
